rep.profile.title: Lyceum profile
dream.rules.body: You can choose up to 3 lyceums in order of priority. Your score is checked against your 1st choice first. If it's enough, you're admitted there and the 2nd and 3rd aren't considered. If not, your 2nd choice is checked, then the 3rd. If none fits, your result is shown under your 1st choice. Put your real dream first and a safer option third.
